explanation: Check odd starting values in increasing order. Track each trajectory to detect cycles, stop below the starting value, and reuse a cache of previously verified odd trajectory values. Even starts immediately reduce to smaller starts.
timeComplexity: O(T) expected time for T examined trajectory steps.
spaceComplexity: O(V+S) space for V cached verified values and the longest local trajectory segment S.
